modalTitle: Charred Letter Found in the Embers
envelopeMessage: You notice a piece of parchment left behind as you arrive home.

defaults.premise: "I still feel your touch on my skin, and I've arranged a private place where we won't be interrupted."
defaults.clue: "Slip out toward {location} as soon as the house is quiet."
defaults.signOff: (The bottom half of the letter has been charred black in the fire, destroying the writer's name.)

Romantic.salutation: "My forbidden love {partner}, last night in my arms was still not enough..."

Humble.salutation: "Dearest {partner}, please don't let guilt keep you from our bed tonight..."

Independent.salutation: "{partner}, come to me again tonight—our secret stays between the two of us..."

Proud.salutation: "My magnificent {partner}, no one else could ever match the passion we shared..."

Jealous.salutation: "{partner}, forget your absent partner and come back to my bed tonight..."
